ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: An Introduction to Hermitian Analysis. We will begin by discussing Fourier series. We will develop the theory of Hilbert spaces, including orthonormal expansion, orthogonal projection, and compact operators. We will discuss connections with differential equations such as Sturm-Liouville equations and some special functions that arise. We will conclude with some topics in Cauchy-Riemann Geometry; the precise topics chosen will depend on student interest. The course should be of interest to students in mathematics, physics, and electrical engineering. Prerequisites: Math 416 (Honors section preferred), Math 424 or Math 447 (Math 424 preferred), some acquaintance with complex analysis. (446 or 448 is more than adequate; having seen complex numbers in physics or engineering is adequate).
